The way you do anything is the way you do everything.

Kevin Trudeau explains one idea he picked up in his time in a private group: live with deliberate intent.

He says that whatever they did, they did it with awareness and full consciousness, from looking at a piece of art to spending time with other people. Nothing ran on autopilot.

The takeaway: small everyday actions done with attention shape the habits behind everything else.

What would change in your week if you did one routine task with full attention?
